message: <tddr-if> test="(a || b" can't be written as a template condition: a ( isn't closed
hint: A condition is a dotted name (paid), a comparison (status == 'paid', qty == 0, a.id != b.id, flag == true, note == null), a list test (items.length != 0), or these combined with !, && and || and parentheses.
Write the condition in test: <tddr-if test="order.paid">.
data-email-else is valueless and shows when nothing before it does; for a condition use data-email-else-if.
<tddr-if> has no box of its own; its children take its place. Put classes, styles and other attributes on them.
